intro: Every engagement starts with a consultation. Pricing is shared there, once Halie knows what you're dressing for.
note: Prices are set after the consultation and depend on scope. Ask, and Halie will tell you plainly.

packages.name: Consultation
packages.body: A deep dive into your style goals, what's in your closet now, and how Halie can help. You leave with a clear plan and a price for the rest.

packages.name: Color analysis and wardrobe audit
packages.body: Your natural undertones and the colors that complement them, then a piece-by-piece audit of what you own. What is working, what can change, what's missing.

packages.name: Shopping
packages.body: Curated selections from vintage, high street, athletic, and custom, sourced to your plan and your budget. In person or as a pull sent to you.

packages.name: Event and photoshoot styling
packages.body: A look for a night out, a wedding, a gala, or a branding shoot. Halie styles the set and the outfit so the photos hold up.

packages.name: Edits and updates
packages.body: Additional edits when needed, seasonal updates, and guidance on mixing and matching, so the wardrobe keeps up with your life.
